    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.boundaryLinear_rank_le_at_rigid (k : Type u_1) [Field k] {C : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_3, u_2} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] [∀ (X Y : C), Module.Finite k (X ⟶ Y)] {X Y A B : C} (u σ : X ⟶ Y) (q : A ⟶ B) (hu : Function.Surjective ⇑(boundaryLinear k u u)) :
    Module.finrank k ↥(boundaryLinear k σ q).range ≤ Module.finrank k ↥(boundaryLinear k u q).range ∧ Module.finrank k ↥(boundaryLinear k q σ).range ≤ Module.finrank k ↥(boundaryLinear k q u).range

    A rigid differential maximizes the rank of the homotopy boundary on fixed terms, in either variable. The comparison holds over finite fields as well.
